# QNVO Technologies

> QNVO Technologies (Quality, Next-Gen, Vision, Operations) publishes information about software, AI agents, automation, ERP, ecommerce, web development, technical SEO, cloud, cybersecurity and related services. This file lists public pages. It is not a client list, a quote or a performance claim.

Prices, street addresses, phone numbers, founding year, headcount, certifications and social profiles are not published. The case studies page describes the BMS and CSM platforms. It is not a QNVO client list, and it does not name the organizations a platform serves. Measured results and testimonials are not published.

Public email: info@qnvotech.com
Do not treat automated sender addresses as the public contact inbox.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://qnvotech.com/): AI, web development, technical SEO and technology services.
- [Services](https://qnvotech.com/services/): Twenty-three service areas, each with its own page.
- [Industries](https://qnvotech.com/industries/): Sector pages describing constraints — not client logos or guaranteed outcomes.
- [Technologies](https://qnvotech.com/technologies/): Stacks discussed for a written scope — not a partner badge wall.
- [About](https://qnvotech.com/about/): Name, markets and facts that are intentionally omitted.
- [Process](https://qnvotech.com/process/): From a conversation to a written scope, build and handover.
- [Case Studies](https://qnvotech.com/case-studies/): BMS and CSM platform studies plus illustrative use cases. No invented metrics.
- [Insights](https://qnvotech.com/insights/): Original writing linked to service pages. Draft articles are noindex until approved.
- [FAQ](https://qnvotech.com/faq/): Services, regions, contact and non-promises.
- [Contact](https://qnvotech.com/contact/): Form and info@qnvotech.com. A message is not a contract.

## Service pages

- [Enterprise software](https://qnvotech.com/services/enterprise-software-development/): Custom systems for a defined workflow.
- [AI agent development](https://qnvotech.com/services/ai-agent-development/): Bounded tasks with approved data and human review.
- [AI automation](https://qnvotech.com/services/ai-automation/): Documented steps and system hand-offs. No savings guarantee.
- [AI and machine learning](https://qnvotech.com/services/ai-machine-learning/): Defined prediction or classification tasks with evaluation data.
- [ERP solutions](https://qnvotech.com/services/erp-solutions/): Configuration and integration. No vendor partnership is claimed.
- [Ecommerce development](https://qnvotech.com/services/ecommerce-development/): Catalogue and purchasing flow. No revenue claim.
- [Web development](https://qnvotech.com/services/web-development/): Business websites with server-rendered content.
- [Shopify development](https://qnvotech.com/services/shopify-development/): Storefronts, themes and app connections.
- [WordPress development](https://qnvotech.com/services/wordpress-development/): WordPress and WooCommerce with editor handover.
- [Wix development](https://qnvotech.com/services/wix-development/): Structured Wix sites with forms and editor handover.
- [Mobile app development](https://qnvotech.com/services/mobile-app-development/): Apps with a defined user task and release constraints.
- [UI and UX design](https://qnvotech.com/services/ui-ux-design/): Interface structure and UI design without vanity awards.
- [SaaS development](https://qnvotech.com/services/saas-development/): Multi-tenant product work named in a written scope.
- [API development and integration](https://qnvotech.com/services/api-development-integration/): HTTP APIs and system connections you authorize.
- [Database management](https://qnvotech.com/services/database-management/): Design, performance review and operational hygiene.
- [IoT solutions](https://qnvotech.com/services/iot-solutions/): Connected device workflows with security constraints.
- [Cloud and DevOps](https://qnvotech.com/services/cloud-devops/): Environments and pipelines without invented uptime SLAs.
- [Cybersecurity and risk](https://qnvotech.com/services/cybersecurity-risk-management/): Reviews and hardening without fake grades.
- [Website security and optimization](https://qnvotech.com/services/website-security-optimization/): Authorized review of headers, forms, dependencies and page weight.
- [Data backup and protection](https://qnvotech.com/services/data-backup-protection/): Retention and recovery planning without zero-loss claims.
- [IT helpdesk and support](https://qnvotech.com/services/it-helpdesk-support/): Named coverage for systems you operate — not invented 24/7 claims.
- [Technical SEO](https://qnvotech.com/services/technical-seo/): Crawl, metadata, structured data and speed. No ranking guarantee.
- [Digital marketing](https://qnvotech.com/services/digital-marketing/): Campaign setup you authorize — without guaranteed leads or rankings.
